description: Link a FAILED step of an execution to a defect that ALREADY EXISTS (e.g. DE-60) — what "link defect" on the report step does — and make sure the step's test case + version is on the defect's TEST CASE field, so the link shows from the defect, the test case and the execution report. Pass `executionId` (EX-170 or 170), `step` (must have failed) and `defectId` (id, code or exact name); `tc` only when the execution ran several test cases. Linking a step that is already linked changes nothing. To create a new defect from the step, use defect_create_from_step.

defectId.description: The existing defect: id, code (DE-60) or exact name.

executionId.description: Execution id or code: EX-170 or 170.

step.description: Step number as shown in the report; it must be a FAILED step.

tc.description: Test case id or code (TC-41) — only when the execution ran several test cases.

name: defect_link_step
title: Link a failed execution step to an existing defect
